title: SPENCER'S METALIC MUG GUN REVOLVER SHAPED NOVELTY Gray Silver Crack Inside
descriptionText:
Crack on the inside. See pics.

This unique mug features a painted design with a novelty pattern that is perfect for all occasions. The mug is made of high-quality ceramic and porcelain materials that ensure durability. It comes in a metalic silver color that adds a touch of elegance to your dinnerware collection. 

The mug is designed in the shape of a gun revolver, making it a great addition to any collection of novelty items. It is perfect for use at home or in the office. The set includes only one mug, making it a great gift for anyone who loves unique and unusual items.
